fields.knob: the knob, idea or condition the record is about (in dead_ends: the idea that was measured)
fields.metric: what the record carries (a registry field name such as status, notes, effect, setting, or the measured quantity)
fields.value: the knob's value (alpha for the alpha / cap / LER rows; otherwise the setting or measured value as named by knob / metric)
fields.code: the problem (code and basis), e.g. bb144 xyz = bb144_unif_p1e-3_r12_xyz
fields.ratio: a ratio (paired failure ratio against the reference named in metric, unless metric says otherwise); a list is a range
fields.p_value: McNemar p-value of the paired comparison
fields.failures: failures of the configuration on those shots
fields.ref_failures: failures of the reference on the same shots
fields.ler: logical error rate (failures / shots) as recorded
fields.p50_us: median latency or change of it, microseconds
fields.p99_us: 99th-percentile latency or change of it, microseconds
fields.exact: true when the knob changes no output (bit-identical), false when it is lossy

fields.revive_if: the registry's condition under which the dead end should be re-measured
fields.check_per_problem: the registry marks the result as problem-dependent: re-check it per problem
fields.note: the measurement record's text; labels and wording were generalised, numbers are as recorded

components.note: us, p50 / p99 of the call on machine A. Best exact library at the time = build 6e; 6f is not yet measured on machine A. Refit: the 6e line is p = t_fixed + cap * t_iter (+ osd_path_p99 for the tail), where t_fixed now INCLUDES the OSD path (osd_path_p50 is folded into it = 0.0): the new libraries (OSD prefix on the device, mapped hand-over) no longer permit the old fixed/OSD split from BP-only cap 1 lines. 6e has only ONE directly measured point on machine A (cap 3, alpha 0.3125: 40.60 / 52.30, the paired series); the other caps are DERIVED = 6c's machine-A rows of the second pooled series (cap 3/5/7/11/31 at alphas .3125/.3125/.375/.5/.5) plus the 6e-vs-6c per-class OSD deltas of the paired series (cap 7 -8.76, cap 11 -13.85, cap 31 -39.08 p50; -8.58 / -13.69 / -40.37 p99). Least-squares over cap 3/7/11/31: p50 = 16.07 + 8.191*cap (residuals <= 0.4 us), p99 = 27.08 + 8.481*cap (residuals <= 1.4 us). Alpha shifts the line by <~1 us (legacy-base low-cap series). A direct 6e cap sweep on machine A replaces this. Raw measured points: target_points. Note for predictions with extra knobs: every exact knob up to and including 6e (the build steps of 6a .. 6e, and all knobs before 6a) is ALREADY INSIDE this fit; its deltas are per-step values vs the previous step and must not be added again.
